comparison.objective: Place three rolled sock pairs in one layer in an open drawer and push the drawer shut; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Soft-item arrangement and drawer actuation versus narrow-tool alignment, impact force regulation, and small rigid-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Three pairs lie in one layer and drawer closes under the top; no specs or clearance thresholds provided. Candidate requires four safe notch fractures and total containment.
comparison.reason: Soft-goods packing and closure is a different physical outcome from precision impact fracture.
